instrument: §285 offline inventory — completion and report surfaces

inventory.dataLossBasis: The surface accepts no input; it renders a completed record or a library of them.

reading.excerpt: NO CONNECTION | This page needs a connection | Safety InSite could not reach the network, and this screen was not saved on this device. | Field Capture still works. Observations, locations and photos you record there are saved on this device and sync when you are back online. | HazLenz AI analysis, report generation and PDF export need a connection. They run on Safety InSite's servers, so they resume

inventory.dataLossBasis: The surface accepts no input; it renders a completed record or a library of them.

reading.excerpt: Home | Inspect | Reports | Calendar | Settings | Offline | RI | SERVER-BACKED RECORDS | Inspection Reports | Every completed inspection has one report. Finishing an inspection again replaces its report, so what you download here is always the current record. | Failed to fetch | Reports are unavailable | Nothing local is being shown as a successful report. Retry after the server connection is restored. | Retry

generationInterrupted.interpretation: NOT_EXERCISED — the generate request completed ({"ok":true,"status":201}) before the abort fired, so no interruption occurred. The revision count moved 4 -> 4 because the generation SUCCEEDED, which evidences nothing about a dropped connection. Measuring this properly needs the connection cut at the transport, not an abort racing a fast local server, and that belongs with D-042.
